Exercise: Pull Through

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- hip_hinge

Primary Muscles:

- glutes

Secondary Muscles:

- hamstrings
- lower back

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2

Energy Requirement:
aerobic and anaerobic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- lower_back_support
- hamstring_engagement
- glute_activation_and_strengthening

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain (unless cleared by a healthcare professional)

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Pull Through, equipment: cable
- exercise_name: Pull Through with Dumbbells, equipment: dumbbells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Romanian Deadlift, equipment: barbell
- exercise_name: Good Morning, equipment: cable

Instructions:

- Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley with a rope or handle attached. Face away from the machine, straddling the cable, with your feet set wide apart.
- Begin the movement by reaching through your legs as far as possible, bending at the hips. Keep your knees slightly bent. Keeping your arms straight, extend through the hip to stand straight up. Avoid pulling upward through the shoulders; all of the motion should originate through the hips.
